changelog:
Initial release of restore-and-upscale skill.

- Upscales and restores degraded, blurry, or low-resolution images with no content change.
- Supports deblurring, denoising, dehazing, artifact removal, and enlargement up to 4x.
- Automatically selects the best model (Real-ESRGAN, SwinIR, Clarity, CCSR, Bria FIBO Edit, or Topaz Starlight) based on the type of damage and user goal.
- Provides clear guidance on model limitations, including no face-specific restoration.
- Features a structured workflow for image and video inputs, with tips for best results.
